recorded: Original served by http-server 14.1.1 with npx http-server@14.1.1 . -p $PORT instead of npm start, which serves port 8080, and opened in headless Google Chrome 152 with no file patched. Chrome 152 exposes LanguageModel to pages, but a fresh headless profile reports the model downloadable and refuses to download it without a user gesture, and pages no longer get params(), so a script that runs before the page's own replaces LanguageModel with a stand-in, or removes it and window.chrome in the case without the API. The stand-in records every call, with prompts' whitespace collapsed, functions and signals named by type, and an abort only while its stream is open. It answers each availability check with the state the case needs, answers params() with the values Chrome documents, reports download progress in three steps, refuses the download with Chrome 152's message in the case that needs it, and streams chunks 30 ms apart, holding the first stream after five chunks in the case that stops it. The chunks are the answers gemma4:12b-mlx gave through Ollama 0.40.11, recorded with record.mjs as a stand-in for Gemini Nano, for the page's system prompt and each question at the case's temperature and top-k, without its thinking. MutationObservers keep each distinct text the output and the button show, with whitespace collapsed, and console.log is wrapped to keep what the page logs. Every case passed in each of 20 runs.

values: Processing your question...

O Top K limita o modelo a escolher a próxima palavra apenas entre as K palavras mais prováveis da distribuição de probabilidade, tornando as respostas mais focais e coerentes ao evitar palavras de baixa probabilidade.
